::: {.hero}
I am a Research Officer and Software Engineer at the Australian National University, working across computational geodynamics, geophysics, numerical modelling, high-performance computing, and open-source research software.

My current work focuses on the Underworld geodynamics codebase, with interests in finite-element modelling, subduction-zone dynamics, megathrust seismicity, geophysical data interpretation, and reproducible scientific computing.

[Research](research.qmd){.btn .btn-primary} [Software](software.qmd){.btn .btn-outline-primary} [Publications](publications.qmd){.btn .btn-outline-secondary}
:::

## Research Interests

::: {.interest-grid}
::: {.research-card}
### Computational geodynamics

Numerical models of mantle and lithosphere dynamics, including Stokes-flow systems, subduction margins, tectonic loading, and benchmark problems.
:::

::: {.research-card}
### Geophysics and Earth systems

Gravity, geoid, seismic imaging, geophysical interpretation, GIS, and links between observations and process-based models.
:::

::: {.research-card}
### Research software

Development, testing, documentation, and training for open-source geodynamics tools, especially Underworld and Python-based modelling workflows.
:::
:::

## Featured Work

- **Underworld3 development:** open-source development for geodynamics modelling, user-facing interfaces, testing, debugging, documentation, and training.
- **Megathrust and subduction dynamics:** numerical modelling of tectonic coupling and loading along active convergent margins, including the Sunda margin.
- **Benchmarking and reproducibility:** finite-element benchmarks, PETSc-based workflows, HPC diagnostics, and reproducible scientific computing.
